# David Maguire

::: {.lead}
I work in data and analytics in banking and am preparing a PhD in quantitative finance. My proposed
research asks whether several large language models, given the same calibrated market evidence and made
to challenge one another, make better investment decisions than they do independently or than strong
quantitative methods alone, and whether any gain is worth its cost. This site sets out the proposal,
its research questions, and the methods it relies on.
:::
:::

## How I decide what to publish

Nothing goes on this site until I can answer six questions about it without notes:
what it means in plain English, why it matters in quant finance, what the equation
or model is actually doing, what it assumes, where it can fail, and how I would
implement it in Python. If I can't answer those, the material stays private until
I can. The goal is demonstrated understanding, not coverage.
